hero.lead: I build efficient, user-focused websites and software.

about.title: About
about.body: Informatics graduate from Institut Teknologi Kalimantan with experience building websites and software. I care about clean architecture, system design, and technology that fits real business needs. I like building tools that simplify workflows and make technology easier to use.

projects.title: Projects
projects.next: More case studies are on the way.

items.water: Web app for modeling pressurized water distribution networks: pipes, nodes, pumps, valves and tanks. Runs hydraulic simulations on a self-built engine and shows results as charts, tables and maps, with CSV/JSON export. Built as a final-year project.
items.simu: Rust REST API for user management: create, update, delete and fetch users. Built together with a classmate.
items.kramakata: Website for a creative design studio covering branding, print and digital work, with an animated book to browse publications.
items.sentry: Company profile site for PT Sentinel Mitra Adiyaksa, a national security services company.
items.fed: Website for FED Insight Indonesia, a human capital consulting firm in Jakarta.
items.noble: Property database management system for Noble Property Asia: apartments, homes, offices and land with photos, specs, pricing and lease terms.
items.asmr: Point-of-sale and stock management system for a car spare-parts retailer, with cashier, purchasing, stock mutation, invoices and a mini finance report.
